description: This file defines a custom annotation called AllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespace used in the OpenMRS project. The annotation indicates that a method (usually a setter) permits strings with leading or trailing whitespace and is intended to be applied on setter methods to relax default whitespace trimming behavior during persistence.

classes.name: AllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespace
classes.description: A custom Java annotation used to mark setter methods that allow leading or trailing whitespace in string values within the OpenMRS system.
